implemented_route: apps/cli -> Engine::execute/execute_inner -> input::seal -> input::interpret -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::CsvGroupStatistics -> document::csv_group_statistics -> parse_csv -> math::summarize for each first-seen exact decoded string group -> source-preserving DocumentResult artifact -> Core dependencies and rendered output
supported_behavior: The Japanese header CSVの「group」ごとに「value」の統計量を計算して: and strict quoted English csv-group-statistics "group" "value": select two distinct named columns.
Grouping uses exact decoded CSV string values in first-seen order; no case folding, trimming, Unicode normalization or numeric interpretation is applied to group keys.
Each group must contain either unitless exact arithmetic expressions or unit-bearing decimal literals. Mixed interpretations within one group stop with a typed error.
Each group receives exact descriptive statistics; identical declared units remain as supplied and mixed conversions are limited to explicit mm/cm/m/km values handled by the existing math component.
The output report records group values, source record numbers, exact statistics, original group-key/value cell byte spans, header spans and the complete source digest.
The existing CSV/document limits apply: at most 256000 source/output bytes, 4096 data rows, 256 columns and 65536 cells.
known_limits: No test or ordinary CLI route was executed for this slice.

Only an explicitly supplied CSV table with a header, two distinct named columns and numeric measured values is supported; empty tables and invalid measured values suspend. Group keys may be arbitrary decoded strings.
The operation describes supplied rows and does not infer population representativeness or general table schemas.
